questions.question: Seven people A–G have exactly two married couples. A, a man, is B’s father; B is C’s brother. C is married to D and is mother of son E. F is A’s wife and mother of B and C. G is B’s daughter. Which named person is E’s mother’s brother’s daughter?
questions.explanation: E’s mother is C, her brother is B, and B’s daughter is G.

questions.question: X @ Y denotes X is Y’s father; X # Y denotes X is Y’s mother; X $ Y denotes X is Y’s sister. In M @ N # P $ Q, which person’s gender is NOT fixed?
questions.explanation: M is male, N female and P female; Q is only described as P’s sibling.

questions.question: At a Jalandhar reunion, a man, Tarun, introduces a boy: “His father’s mother is my mother’s sister.” Which woman connects the boy’s father to Tarun as cousins?

options.label: A
options.text: The boy’s sister and Tarun’s mother

options.label: B
options.text: The boy’s maternal grandmother and Tarun’s mother

options.label: C
options.text: The boy’s paternal grandmother and Tarun’s mother

options.label: D
options.text: The boy’s mother and Tarun’s sister

questions.explanation: The boy’s father and Tarun have mothers who are sisters: the boy’s paternal grandmother and Tarun’s mother.

questions.question: A is B’s brother. B is C’s daughter. C’s gender is unstated. Which conclusion cannot be fixed without C’s gender?

options.label: B
options.text: Whether C is A’s father or mother

options.label: D
options.text: Whether A and B are siblings

questions.explanation: A and B share parent C, but no word fixes C as male or female.

questions.question: Code: X + Y means X is Y’s father; X - Y means X is Y’s sister; X * Y means X is Y’s son. In A - B + C * D, replace only the first symbol so that A becomes C’s paternal uncle. Which replacement works?

options.label: D
options.text: No listed symbol can do this

questions.explanation: A must become B’s brother, but the code has father, sister and son only; none supplies brother.

questions.question: A woman, Manpreet, is the sister of a man, Jaswant. Jaswant’s son Kuldeep is married to Reet. Reet’s mother is Savita. Which person is Reet’s husband’s paternal aunt?
questions.explanation: Reet’s husband is Kuldeep; his father Jaswant’s sister is Manpreet.

questions.question: A man, Harpal, has a sister Inderjit and a brother Jagdeep. Inderjit’s son Kamal is father of a daughter, Lavi. What is Jagdeep to Kamal?
questions.explanation: Jagdeep and Inderjit are siblings; Inderjit is Kamal’s mother, so Jagdeep is his maternal uncle.

questions.question: A verbal tree gives three generations: couple R (male)–S (female); their son T and daughter U; T’s son V; U’s daughter W. Who belongs to the youngest generation but is not R’s grandson?
questions.explanation: V and W are the youngest generation; W is a granddaughter, whereas V is a grandson.

questions.question: Which statement alone answers “How is A related to B?” I. A is the only daughter of B’s mother. II. A and B are distinct people, and A is B’s sister. Treat I and II independently.

options.label: A
options.text: I alone, since II gives no gender

options.label: C
options.text: II alone, since I does not exclude A being B

options.label: D
options.text: I alone proves A is B’s mother

questions.explanation: I permits B to be that only daughter A; II explicitly distinguishes them and states sister.

questions.question: In a code, X + Y is X is Y’s wife; X # Y is X is Y’s brother; X @ Y is X is Y’s father. Decode L + M # N @ O. Who is O’s father’s brother’s wife?
questions.explanation: O’s father is N, N’s brother is M, and M’s wife is L.

questions.question: A woman, N, is mother of P. P is parent of Q; Q is father of R. Which description of N relative to R is certain even though P’s gender is unknown?
questions.explanation: R → father Q → parent P → mother N gives three upward links to a female ancestor.

questions.question: A boy, Samar, points to a woman: “My father’s wife is her only daughter.” Samar’s mother and father are married to each other. The woman is Samar’s _____.
questions.explanation: His father’s wife is his mother; her mother is Samar’s maternal grandmother.

questions.question: X / Y means X is Y’s father, X * Y means X is Y’s brother, X - Y means X is Y’s daughter. Which expression establishes both that A is D’s paternal uncle and D is female?
questions.explanation: A is brother of D’s father B; D - C fixes D as female.

questions.question: Six people A–F form three generations with two couples. A is B’s wife. C is their only daughter. E is C’s husband. D is C’s son and F is D’s sister. Every child has both parents in the family. Which pair consists of one male and one female grandchild of A?
questions.explanation: D and F are C’s son and daughter; C is A’s daughter, so both are A’s grandchildren through her.

questions.question: A woman, Bharti, has daughter Charanpreet. Charanpreet is married to Daler. Daler’s elder sister is Ekam. Which statement about Bharti is established?
questions.explanation: Bharti is the mother of Daler’s wife Charanpreet, hence his mother-in-law.

questions.question: A man, Ashwin, has a younger sister Bhavana. Bhavana’s daughter Chahat has a son Darsh. Identify Ashwin’s relationship to Chahat’s mother.
questions.explanation: Chahat’s mother is Bhavana, who is Ashwin’s younger sister; therefore Ashwin is her elder brother.

questions.question: In one family, each son has 2 brothers and each daughter has 3 sisters. All children share the same two parents. Including the parents, how many members are there?
questions.explanation: There are 3 sons and 4 daughters; adding 2 parents gives 9 members.

questions.question: In a verbal tree, A (male) and B (female) have son C and daughter D. C and wife E have daughter F. D and husband G have son H. Which person is both H’s maternal uncle and F’s father?
questions.explanation: C is the brother of H’s mother D and is explicitly F’s father.

questions.question: A is B’s sister, B is C’s brother, and C is D’s mother. The ages are not given. Which person is certainly female and in D’s mother’s generation, but is not D’s mother?
questions.explanation: A, B and C are siblings; A is female and is the sister of D’s mother C.

questions.question: X + Y means X is Y’s father; X @ Y means X is Y’s wife; X # Y means X is Y’s sister. All letters denote distinct people. Which expression can represent a valid family without conflicting genders? Assume husbands are male and wives female.
questions.explanation: In the valid expression A is female, B male and C female. The alternatives force C or B to be both male and female.

questions.question: A woman, Garima, introduces a man: “My daughter is his son’s wife.” Garima’s daughter is Hina and the man’s son is Irfan. Which pair is necessarily married?
questions.explanation: The stated daughter Hina is the stated son Irfan’s wife.

questions.question: Code: X % Y means X is Y’s daughter; X + Y means X is Y’s father; X @ Y means X is Y’s husband. In P % Q @ R, which additional coded fact proves that R is P’s mother without relying on a spouse-parent convention?
questions.explanation: Q @ R fixes R as female; P % R then explicitly makes P R’s daughter, proving maternity.

questions.question: To decide whether P is Q’s maternal grandfather: I. P is father of R and R is Q’s parent. II. R is female. Which sufficiency decision is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Both are required and together sufficient

questions.explanation: I gives a grandfather but leaves the side unknown; II makes parent R the mother, establishing the maternal side.

questions.question: A woman, Kiran, is wife of Lalit. Lalit’s mother Mansi has a brother, Naresh. Naresh’s daughter is Oorja. What is Mansi to Kiran’s husband?
questions.explanation: Kiran’s husband is Lalit, whose mother is explicitly Mansi; the Naresh–Oorja branch is irrelevant.

questions.question: R is father of S. S is sister of T, and T is father of U. V is U’s mother’s sister. What relationship between R and V is established by these facts?

options.label: D
options.text: R’s son is the father of V’s sister’s child

questions.explanation: R’s son T is U’s father; U’s mother is V’s sister, so the first description preserves every stated link.
